A GPU-first plane-wave density functional theory code written in
[JAX](https://jax.readthedocs.io).

The project has two goals, in this order: to explore building a substantial
scientific code through agentic development, and to produce real, verifiable
physics along the way. Correctness, clarity and sound architecture matter more
than feature count or peak performance.

## How each milestone is built

Every milestone goes through the same steps, and none is skipped:

1. A **theory post** states the physics, the conventions and the acceptance
   criteria.
2. The theory post is **reviewed** before any code is written.
3. The acceptance criteria become **failing tests**, with reference data.
4. The **implementation** is written until those tests pass. The tests are
   not changed to fit it.
5. A **validation document** compares the results with analytic limits,
   published numbers and reference codes, and interprets the deviations.

The figures and numbers below are computed by the validation documents each
time the site is built. A document that no longer agrees with the code fails
the build.

## Sections

- [Theory](theory/index.qmd): one post per milestone, scoped to that
  milestone's physics.
- [Concepts](concepts/index.qmd): pedagogical explainers of background ideas,
  with the code shown.
- [Ideas](ideas/index.qmd): exploratory tests of speculative methods on small
  model problems.
- [Validation](validation/index.qmd): comparisons against analytic limits,
  published results and reference codes, with interpretation.
- [Engineering](engineering/index.qmd): the engineering log, performance
  tracking and project statistics.
- [Research](research/index.qmd): the research log of physical results.
- [Conversations](conversations/index.qmd): excerpts of the conversations
  with Claude in which the project is developed.
